Design and Build Anaplan Application Models to Support Planning Process Anaplan Certified Model Builder Experience in Development,Testing and in making Production Models for the end users.

responsibilities: To monitor the Service Now queue for Anaplan incidents.
Worked on handling Service Now Anaplan tickets and providing the resolution on various issues related to Distribution Resource Planning.
Worked closely with the Client to give the updates & receive inputs on topics related to the tickets.
Worked on User Access Management by providing the appropriate access to the team members.
Assisted the team members in issues if they are stuck & also took helped each other to gain more knowledge.
Worked on Cloudworks.
Worked with cross-functional teams like Snowflake, Informatica, Boomi teams to ensure integration transmission done successfully to investigate Data discrepancy.
Interacted with various end users belonging to various countries like Spain, Japan, Portugal, etc., for understanding the ticket so as to provide the clear resolution.
Understanding the new requirements of the model building
Managed the process of Development,Testing and Production with ALM.
Data, import, creation of import and delete Actions and creation of Processes
Provided security levels roles, selective access and DCA for the user access control.
By following PLANS, and DISCO, created the lists, modules UX pages and, and also created actions.
Worked on designing and building the model
Preparing Various types of reports like Operational, Financial, Revenue, Forecast etc.
Anaplan– S&OP Use Case:
Built and optimized Anaplan models for demand forecasting and supply planning, aligning operations with sales targets.
Conducted scenario planning to evaluate the impact of, market variables on supply chain operations.
Developed models to optimize inventory, levels,, reducing excess stock and enhancing efficiency.
Facilitated collaboration between sales, operations, and finance teams,ensuring alignment on S&OP plans.
Generated interactive dashboards for real-time performance tracking and data-driven decision-making

Through the Anaplan Level 1 Model Building (L1) certification, I gained foundational knowledge of Anaplan, including how to build modules, lists, line items, and dashboards. Learned to import and export data, apply basic formulas, and design simple yet effective planning models using the DISCO methodology. This level focused on core model-building skills and introduced structured thinking for scalable model design.

The Level 2 Model Building (L2) certification deepened my expertise by simulating real-world business scenarios across functions like FP&A, Demand Planning, and Supply Chain. I learned to create and maintain a centralized Data Hub, handle complex formulas, build dynamic reports, and apply best practices for model connectivity and data flow. L2 also introduced Application Lifecycle Management (ALM) concepts and emphasized performance optimization for large-scale models.
